before.path:
# /etc/systemd/system/davinci-fonts-refresh.path
[Unit]
Description=Refresh DaVinci font cache when shared font directory changes

[Path]
PathChanged=/opt/resolve/Shared-Fonts-Cloud9
Unit=davinci-assets-refresh.service

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
before.service:
# /etc/systemd/system/davinci-assets-refresh.service
[Unit]
Description=Refresh DaVinci Resolve shared fonts and LUT metadata
ConditionPathIsDirectory=/opt/resolve/LUT

[Service]
Type=oneshot
User=arezki
Group=arezki
Environment=HOME=/home/arezki
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/davinci-assets-refresh.sh
Nice=10
IOSchedulingClass=best-effort
IOSchedulingPriority=7

after.new_timer:
[Unit]
Description=DaVinci assets refresh, native rate-limited
After=network-online.target

[Timer]
OnBootSec=3min
OnUnitActiveSec=30min
AccuracySec=2min
Unit=davinci-assets-refresh.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target

cause: PathChanged on NFS/symlink font directory caused rapid repeated no-op starts and start-limit-hit on Oct23
effect: Reuse existing service and its hash-based skip; native systemd timer every 30m instead of event storm
rollback: systemctl disable --now davinci-assets-refresh.timer; rm /etc/systemd/system/davinci-assets-refresh.timer; systemctl daemon-reload; systemctl enable --now davinci-fonts-refresh.path
